verdict.rationale:
Framer ships a built-in AI agent (framer.com/ai) that creates editable pages, sections, copy, and visuals directly in the project, refines them conversationally, and hands off to canvas editing—covering style changes, layout reorganization, typography, and color updates (framer-docs-6, framer-docs-7, framer-docs-19, framer-docs-20, framer-docs-27, framer-docs-31, framer-docs-37). This is distinct from the external-agent/MCP-less integration for third-party tools, which is a separate capability.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reviews or benchmarks of the built-in AI agent's output quality; community evidence pack only covers older non-AI Framer features.
